Arjuna then presses on into the army, followed by the Panchalas, and Jaya, Kritavarman and others rush to block him.

scenes.B07C088S01: Arjuna's request for Drona's blessing, their duel at the entrance of the array, and Arjuna's push forward past Drona toward Jayadratha.

shots.B07C088S01H01: Arjuna asks Drona for his blessing, saying he is like a father to him, and asks to pass through the array to kill Jayadratha.
shots.B07C088S01H02: Drona says Arjuna must first defeat him, and the two duel, with Drona cutting Arjuna's bowstring and burying him in arrows; Krishna then urges Arjuna to go around Drona and press on.
shots.B07C088S01H03: Drona asks where Arjuna is going, and Arjuna replies that Drona is his teacher and not his foe.
shots.B07C088S01H04: Arjuna plunges into the army, the Panchala princes follow him, and Jaya, Kritavarman and other allies rush to stop him.

B07C089.summary: Drona pursues Arjuna, but Arjuna keeps moving through the Kaurava ranks, trading arrows with Drona and then with Kritavarman, Srutayudha and Sudakshina. Srutayudha dies when his magic mace, which Varuna had warned must not be thrown at an unengaged foe, turns back on him after he hurls it at Krishna. Sudakshina of the Kambojas also falls, and the Kaurava troops flee.

scenes.B07C089S01: Arjuna's duels with Drona, Kritavarman, Srutayudha and Sudakshina, and the death of these allies of the Kauravas.

shots.B07C089S01H01: Arjuna fights his way forward past Drona, then defeats Kritavarman, Srutayudha and Sudakshina, and Srutayudha dies when his mace turns back on him; Sudakshina then falls, and the troops flee.

B07C090.summary: The Kaurava allies press in against Arjuna in great numbers, but he cuts them down. A spear thrust leaves him senseless for a while until Krishna comforts him, and then he destroys the brothers Srutayus and Achyutayus with a celestial weapon. He goes on slaughtering the Kaurava forces, including many foreign warriors, until the field is covered with blood. Finally he kills Srutayus of the Amvashthas and disappears under a mass of enemy chariots and elephants.

scenes.B07C090S01: Arjuna's slaughter of the Kaurava allies, his temporary collapse under a spear and Krishna's comfort, and the end of the battle at the blood river.

shots.B07C090S01H01: Arjuna wipes out wave after wave of Kaurava allies, is knocked senseless by a spear and comforted by Krishna, kills the brothers Srutayus and Achyutayus, and continues the massacre of foreign troops until the field is a river of blood, ending with the death of Srutayus of the Amvashthas and Arjuna being surrounded.

B07C091.summary: Duryodhana rushes to Drona in alarm, saying Arjuna has broken through the army and blaming Drona for failing to protect Jayadratha. Drona replies that Arjuna's chariot is too fast for him to catch, that he is too old, and that Duryodhana must fight Arjuna himself. Drona then ties a golden armour on Duryodhana with sacred words and explains that the armour once belonged to Shiva, passed to Indra for his battle against Vritra, and reached Drona through a chain of teachers.

scenes.B07C091S01: Duryodhana's appeal to Drona, Drona's refusal to chase Arjuna, and Drona's blessings and story of the armour as it is tied on Duryodhana.
scenes.B07C091S02: Drona's account of how the armour passed from Shiva to Drona, and the armoured Duryodhana setting out against Arjuna.

shots.B07C091S01H01: Duryodhana rushes to Drona, says Arjuna has broken through the army, and blames Drona for not stopping him and for failing to save Jayadratha.
shots.B07C091S01H02: Drona says he does not blame Duryodhana, explains that Krishna's horses and Arjuna's arrows are too swift for him, and urges Duryodhana to fight Arjuna himself.
shots.B07C091S01H03: Duryodhana protests that he cannot resist Arjuna, who has already beaten Drona's best allies.
shots.B07C091S01H04: Drona promises that a golden armour will protect Duryodhana from any weapon and urges him to fight Arjuna in it.
shots.B07C091S01H05: Drona blesses Duryodhana by calling on many gods and sages, and tells how Shiva gave his armour to Indra to defeat Vritra.
shots.B07C091S02H01: Drona explains the armour's chain of owners, from Shiva through Angiras and Vrihaspati to himself, and says he uses its sacred words to protect Duryodhana.
shots.B07C091S02H02: Drona fastens the armour on Duryodhana with sacred cords and sends him out; the king advances with elephants, horses and chariots while the troops roar.

B07C092.summary: The Pandavas and Somakas press into Drona's array at the gate, and Dhrishtadyumna forces the Kaurava host into three parts. Drona fights back fiercely and many single combats break out across the field, with Bhimasena, Yudhishthira, Satyaki, Sahadeva, Sikhandin, Ghatotkacha and others each facing a Kaurava champion. Jayadratha stays in the rear, guarded by Kripa, Drona's son, Karna and Salya.

scenes.B07C092S01: The main battle at the gate of Drona's array, the Kaurava host splitting under Dhrishtadyumna's attack, and Jayadratha's rear guard.

shots.B07C092S01H01: The Pandavas and Somakas charge Drona's array, Dhrishtadyumna splits the Kaurava host into three, and Drona fights back while many one-on-one duels break out, including Bhimasena and Yudhishthira against their Kaurava opponents.
shots.B07C092S01H02: Jayadratha stays at the rear, guarded on both wheels by Drona's son and Karna, with Kripa, Salya and others protecting his back.
shots.B07C092S01H03: A heading marking the start of Section XCV.

B07C093.summary: Sanjaya describes a string of separate fights across the field, where Virata and Sikhandin, Satyaki and Duhsasana, the twins Nakula and Sahadeva and Sakuni, and Yudhishthira and Salya clash with fierce arrow fire. The Kaurava allies are forced back, and Sakuni flees toward Drona's division. Sanjaya warns that the anger of the Pandavas, set off by the king's own conduct, now threatens to consume the earth.

scenes.B07C093S01: A series of single combats across the battlefield, ending with Sakuni fleeing and the Pandava fury described as unstoppable.

shots.B07C093S01H01: Sanjaya describes the battle's separate duels, including Vinda and Anuvinda against Virata, Valhika against Sikhandin, Duhsasana against Satyaki, the twins against Sakuni, Yudhishthira against Salya, and Vivinsati's group against Bhimasena.

B07C094.summary: The battle grows more savage, with Bhimasena attacking Jalasandha and Yudhishthira attacking Kritavarman, while Drona and Dhrishtadyumna fight at the centre. Dhrishtadyumna leaps from his chariot with a sword and climbs onto Drona's car, but Drona cuts down his shield and horses. Satyaki rescues Dhrishtadyumna from Drona's grip, and the Panchalas pull Dhrishtadyumna out of the fight.

scenes.B07C094S01: The general carnage of the battle, Dhrishtadyumna's daring leap onto Drona's chariot, and Satyaki's rescue of him.

shots.B07C094S01H01: The Pandavas split off to attack the three Kaurava groups, Drona and Dhrishtadyumna trade fierce arrow fire, and the field fills with the dead and with scavenging animals.
shots.B07C094S01H02: Dhrishtadyumna leaps onto Drona's chariot with a sword, Drona cuts down his shield and horses, Satyaki saves him with arrows, and the Panchalas withdraw him from the battle.

B07C095.summary: Dhritarashtra asks what Drona did after Dhrishtadyumna was rescued. Sanjaya describes a long, evenly matched single combat between Drona and Satyaki, in which Satyaki keeps cutting Drona's bows, and the two armies stop to watch. Drona grudgingly admires Satyaki's skill, and then both men use celestial weapons that cancel each other out. As the sun sets, the Pandavas and Kauravas rush to save their champions, and a dust-filled melee follows.

scenes.B07C095S01: Dhritarashtra's question, the duel between Drona and Satyaki, the cancelled celestial weapons, and the rush to rescue each champion at sunset.

shots.B07C095S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what Drona did after Dhrishtadyumna was rescued by Satyaki.
shots.B07C095S01H02: Drona charges Satyaki, and the two fight a long duel in which Satyaki repeatedly cuts Drona's bows; Drona admires his skill, uses celestial weapons, and both weapons cancel out as the sun sets, drawing rescuers into the fight.

B07C096.summary: As the sun sinks toward the western hills, Arjuna and Krishna drive through the Kaurava ranks toward Jayadratha. Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti attack the tired horses, but Arjuna kills both brothers and their followers. Surrounded by the Kauravas, Arjuna dismounts to stand alone and holds them off, and Krishna then makes a well for the horses and Arjuna builds a hall of arrows.

scenes.B07C096S01: Arjuna and Krishna's advance toward Jayadratha at sunset, the slaying of Vinda and Anuvinda, and Arjuna's stand on foot against the Kaurava army.

shots.B07C096S01H01: As evening falls, Arjuna and Krishna drive their chariot through the Kaurava ranks, guided by arrows that clear the way and by Krishna's skilful driving.
shots.B07C096S01H02: Vinda and Anuvinda attack Arjuna's tired horses, Arjuna kills both brothers and their followers, and the Kaurava forces surround him while he and Krishna discuss what to do next.
shots.B07C096S01H03: Arjuna tells Krishna that he will hold back the army while Krishna looks after the horses.
shots.B07C096S01H04: Arjuna stands alone on the ground against the Kshatriya host, Krishna notes the horses need water, Arjuna pierces the earth with a weapon to make a lake, and then builds an arrow hall, which pleases Krishna.

B07C097.summary: Arjuna keeps the Kaurava kings at bay while fighting on foot, and Krishna unyokes the horses, tends them and gives them water. Once they are rested, the two heroes remount and race toward Jayadratha as the sun sinks. Duryodhana's side despairs, but Duryodhana himself rushes forward to block Arjuna.

scenes.B07C097S01: Arjuna's stand on foot, Krishna's care for the horses, and the renewed charge toward Jayadratha with Duryodhana joining the defence.

shots.B07C097S01H01: Arjuna fights on foot against the kings, Krishna tends the horses and makes them drink, then they remount and charge at Jayadratha while the Kauravas despair and Duryodhana hurries to block them.

B07C098.summary: Vasudeva and Arjuna break through Drona's division and the Bhoja division, leaving the Kauravas stunned and fearful for Jayadratha's life. The two heroes speak together about killing Jayadratha, and Arjuna vows he will not let him escape. Duryodhana then charges out to meet them to protect Jayadratha.

scenes.B07C098S01: Arjuna and Krishna cross the divisions of Drona and the Bhojas, plan Jayadratha's death, and Duryodhana charges to block them.

shots.B07C098S01H01: Arjuna and Krishna pass through Drona's and the Bhojas' divisions, the Kaurava army despairs, Arjuna vows to kill Jayadratha even against Indra, and Duryodhana rides out to stop them.

B07C099.summary: Krishna urges Arjuna to fight Duryodhana directly, calling him the root of the Pandavas' wrongs and recalling the dice game, the exile, and the insult to Draupadi. Arjuna agrees to take him on and the two heroes blow their conches, as the Kauravas fear the king is about to die. Duryodhana then taunts Arjuna to use all his weapons against him.

scenes.B07C099S01: Krishna's speech urging Arjuna to face Duryodhana, Arjuna's agreement, and Duryodhana's challenge to Arjuna.

shots.B07C099S01H01: Krishna urges Arjuna to attack Duryodhana, listing his wrongs against the Pandavas and arguing that his death will open the way forward.
shots.B07C099S01H02: Arjuna agrees and vows to avenge Draupadi's insult; the two heroes blow their conches, and Duryodhana taunts Arjuna to show his skill.

B07C100.summary: Duryodhana wounds both Arjuna and Krishna, but Arjuna's arrows cannot pierce his armour, which Krishna asks about. Arjuna explains that the armour was passed down from Indra through Angiras and Vrihaspati and that Drona put it on Duryodhana, but he still expects to defeat him. Aswatthaman cuts Arjuna's prepared arrows apart, and Arjuna then destroys Duryodhana's horses, chariot and bow. When Krishna blows his conch, the Kauravas scatter, and the protectors of Jayadratha surge forward to face Arjuna.

scenes.B07C100S01: Duryodhana's armour blocks Arjuna's arrows, Aswatthaman blocks the arrows Arjuna prepares, Duryodhana is left carless, and the Kaurava forces rush to protect him.

shots.B07C100S01H01: Duryodhana wounds Arjuna and Krishna, Arjuna's shots bounce off his armour, and Krishna questions Arjuna's strength.
shots.B07C100S01H02: Arjuna explains that the armour came down from Indra through a chain of teachers, that Drona fitted it on Duryodhana, and that he will still win.
shots.B07C100S01H03: Aswatthaman cuts down Arjuna's prepared arrows, Arjuna destroys Duryodhana's horses, charioteers, bow and car, the Kauravas rush to save him, and Krishna's conch and Arjuna's bow scatter them.

B07C101.summary: The Kaurava warriors rush at Arjuna and Krishna, each eager to strike first. Eight champions, including Bhurishravas, Karna, Jayadratha, Kripa and Drona's son Aswatthaman, surround Arjuna. Arjuna answers with his own rapid arrows, breaking Salya's bow and wounding several of the champions, and the field echoes with the blasts of many conches.

scenes.B07C101S01: The Kaurava champions surround Arjuna, the blasts of the conches, and Arjuna's counterattack against the eight champions.

shots.B07C101S01H01: The Kaurava warriors rush forward, the eight protectors of Jayadratha surround Arjuna, the conches sound, and Arjuna cuts down Salya's bow and wounds his many attackers in turn.

B07C102.summary: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya to describe the battle standards of both sides, and Sanjaya lists them in detail. Arjuna's ape banner, Drona's son's lion tail, Karna's elephant rope and the other champions' emblems all stand out, and the Kaurava side has nine standards in its divisions. Sanjaya blames the king's policy for the many kings and armies lost in the fight, and the battle between Arjuna and the Kaurava champions goes on.

scenes.B07C102S01: Dhritarashtra's request, Sanjaya's list of the standards on both sides, and his blame of the king's policy for the slaughter.

shots.B07C102S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya to describe the battle standards of both sides.
shots.B07C102S01H02: Sanjaya lists the banners of the champions, from Arjuna's ape and Drona's son's lion tail to Jayadratha's silver boar and Duryodhana's gem-decked elephant, and then blames the king's policy for the slaughter as Arjuna faces his enemies alone.

B07C103.summary: Sanjaya describes the afternoon fighting, when the Panchalas and Pandavas press hard against Drona's division. Many pairs of warriors clash across the field, including Dhrishtaketu and Viradhanwan, Sahadeva and Durmukha, and Bhima and Alamvusha. Drona fights Yudhishthira, cuts his bow and horses, and leaves him weaponless, and the Pandava troops fear their king has been killed before he escapes on Sahadeva's chariot.

scenes.B07C103S01: The afternoon fighting between the Panchalas and Drona's division, and Drona's defeat of Yudhishthira, which leaves the king fleeing.

shots.B07C103S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what the Panchalas did against Drona's division after Arjuna saw Jayadratha.
shots.B07C103S01H02: The Panchalas and Pandavas strike at Drona's division and many duels break out, until Drona cuts down Yudhishthira's bow, horses and chariot, and the Pandava troops cry out that the king is dead before he escapes on Sahadeva's chariot.

B07C104.summary: Several duels end in one side's victory. Kshemadhurti is killed by Vrihatkshatra, Viradhanwan falls to Dhrishtaketu's iron dart, and Sahadeva defeats Durmukha, then Niramitra. Satyaki beats Vyaghradatta and then the Magadhas, and Drona charges at Satyaki in fury.

scenes.B07C104S01: A run of single combats, each won by a Pandava side or ally, ending with Drona turning on Satyaki.

shots.B07C104S01H01: Vrihatkshatra kills Kshemadhurti, Dhrishtaketu kills Viradhanwan, Sahadeva beats Durmukha and kills Niramitra, Satyaki defeats Vyaghradatta and his Magadha followers, and Drona furiously charges at Satyaki.

B07C105.summary: Somadatta's son attacks the five sons of Draupadi, but they surround him and each strikes a blow, and Sahadeva's son finally beheads him. Then the Rakshasa Alamvusha fights Bhima, conjures illusions, and rains down weapons that drive the Pandava forces back. Bhima answers with the Tvashtri weapon, which drives Alamvusha off the field.

scenes.B07C105S01: Somadatta's son is killed by the five sons of Draupadi, and Bhima's duel with the Rakshasa Alamvusha, ending with Alamvusha's retreat.

shots.B07C105S01H01: Somadatta's son wounds the five sons of Draupadi, then the Pandava princes unite against him, cut down his horses, bow and charioteer, and Sahadeva's son beheads him, which sends the Kaurava troops into flight.
shots.B07C105S01H02: Alamvusha fights Bhima with illusions, recalls that Bhima killed his brother Vaka, and rains down weapons that wreck the Pandava troops, until Bhima strikes back with the Tvashtri weapon and drives him off the field.

B07C106.summary: Ghatotkacha, Hidimva's son, attacks Alamvusha, and the two Rakshasas fight a long duel of illusions. The Pandavas surround Alamvusha with chariots, but he breaks free and wounds many of them. Ghatotkacha then seizes him, hurls him to the ground and crushes him, and the Pandavas celebrate while the Kauravas mourn.

scenes.B07C106S01: Ghatotkacha's duel with Alamvusha, the Pandava attack on Alamvusha, and Ghatotkacha's killing of him.

shots.B07C106S01H01: Ghatotkacha duels Alamvusha with illusions, the Pandavas surround Alamvusha with chariots, Ghatotkacha seizes and crushes him, the Pandavas celebrate, and the Kauravas cry out in grief as Ghatotkacha roars in triumph.

B07C107.summary: Drona fights Satyaki, and Yudhishthira sends his troops to rescue him. Drona then routs the Pandava and Panchala forces, killing many warriors, until Yudhishthira hears Krishna's conch and fears for Arjuna. Yudhishthira then begs Satyaki to go and help Arjuna, pointing out that the Kaurava army is closing in on him and that Satyaki is the only warrior who can do it.

scenes.B07C107S01: Dhritarashtra asks about the Drona and Satyaki duel, the Pandava rush to save Satyaki, and Yudhishthira's appeal to Satyaki to go aid Arjuna.

shots.B07C107S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya to describe how Satyaki fought Drona.
shots.B07C107S01H02: Drona and Satyaki trade arrows, Yudhishthira orders his men to rescue Satyaki, Drona routs the Pandava forces, and Yudhishthira, hearing the Krishna conch and fearing for Arjuna, begs Satyaki to go to Arjuna's side.

B07C108.summary: Satyaki agrees to go to Arjuna's aid, and says he is ready to fight the whole Kaurava army for the king's sake. He repeats Arjuna's own request that Satyaki protect Yudhishthira, saying that Drona is eager to seize the king. Yudhishthira insists that Satyaki should go to Arjuna, and he lists the warriors who will guard him, with Dhrishtadyumna to hold back Drona.

scenes.B07C108S01: Satyaki's pledge to aid Arjuna, his worry about leaving Yudhishthira unguarded, and Yudhishthira's decision to send him onward.

shots.B07C108S01H01: Satyaki pledges to fight the whole Kaurava army and to reach Arjuna, but first passes on Arjuna's request that he guard Yudhishthira against Drona.
shots.B07C108S01H02: Yudhishthira insists Satyaki must go to Arjuna, names the warriors who will protect him, and asserts that Dhrishtadyumna will hold back Drona.

B07C109.summary: Satyaki, afraid of being thought a coward, agrees to leave Yudhishthira and follow Arjuna. He names the Kaurava forces he expects to meet, including Karna's Rukmarathas, the Kiratas, the Kambojas and others, and asks for his chariot to be stocked for a fierce fight. Yudhishthira provides arms, Satyaki's horses are readied and he is blessed by the Brahmanas, and he sends Bhima to guard the king before charging into the Kaurava host.

scenes.B07C109S01: Satyaki's decision to obey Yudhishthira and follow Arjuna, his list of enemy forces, and his departure after the rites and farewell to Bhima.

shots.B07C109S01H01: Satyaki, fearing the charge of cowardice, agrees to follow Arjuna, lists the Kaurava forces he must face, including elephant divisions and warrior groups, and asks for his chariot to be equipped with weapons.
shots.B07C109S01H02: Yudhishthira provides arms, Satyaki's horses are fed and harnessed, the Brahmanas bless him, and after telling Bhima to guard the king, Satyaki charges into the Kaurava army.

B07C110.summary: Satyaki routs the Kaurava troops and fights Drona, who accuses him of abandoning Arjuna in cowardice and threatens him. Satyaki answers that he must follow his teacher Arjuna's path and will not waste time on Drona. He drives toward Karna's host, beheads Kritavarman's charioteer, and is then held up by the Kamboja division while Drona pursues him. Kritavarman fights him in a long duel, and the Pandavas and Panchalas strain to hold their ground.

scenes.B07C110S01: Satyaki's rout of the Kaurava troops, his clash with Drona, his escape toward Karna's host, and his duel with Kritavarman.

shots.B07C110S01H01: Satyaki routs the Kaurava troops and fights Drona, who accuses him of abandoning Arjuna in cowardice and threatens him.
shots.B07C110S01H02: Satyaki answers that he will follow his teacher Arjuna's path and will not waste time fighting Drona.
shots.B07C110S01H03: Satyaki drives toward Karna's host, beheads Kritavarman's charioteer, and then is held up by the Kamboja division while Drona pursues him.
shots.B07C110S01H04: A heading that marks the start of Section CXIII.

B07C111.summary: Dhritarashtra laments that his army, though well paid and well led, is being broken by Arjuna and Satyaki, and asks Sanjaya what happened when the two heroes entered his host. Sanjaya tells him that the king's own greed and refusal to heed Vidura's counsel brought the ruin, and he describes Kritavarman's stand against the Pandavas. Kritavarman wounds Bhima and nearly defeats Sikhandin, and then holds off all the Pandava and Panchala forces on his own.

scenes.B07C111S01: Dhritarashtra's lament over his army's defeat and Sanjaya's reply blaming the king, followed by Kritavarman's one-man stand against the Pandavas.

shots.B07C111S01H01: Dhritarashtra laments that his well-paid army is being destroyed by Arjuna and Satyaki and asks Sanjaya what happened when they entered the host.
shots.B07C111S01H02: Sanjaya blames the king for ignoring Vidura's counsel, then describes how Kritavarman alone holds off the Pandavas, wounds Bhima and Sikhandin, and routs the Pandava and Panchala forces.

B07C112.summary: Satyaki, hearing the uproar, turns back to fight Kritavarman and defeats him, then drives on to face the Trigarta elephant force and scatters it. Jalasandha leads a fresh elephant attack, but Satyaki wounds him, cuts off his arms and beheads him. The Kaurava troops flee in despair, and Drona turns to face Satyaki.

scenes.B07C112S01: Satyaki's duel with Kritavarman, his rout of the Trigarta elephants, his killing of Jalasandha, and Drona's approach.

shots.B07C112S01H01: Satyaki returns to fight Kritavarman, routs his forces, then faces and scatters the Trigarta elephants, kills Jalasandha after a long duel, and the Kaurava troops flee as Drona comes to face Satyaki.

B07C113.summary: Satyaki faces a volley from many Kaurava champions, then wounds Duryodhana, who is forced to flee and take refuge in another chariot. Kritavarman comes to fight Satyaki, but Satyaki wounds and drives him down, and then pushes on through the Kaurava ranks toward Arjuna.

scenes.B07C113S01: Satyaki's clash with Drona, Duhsasana and other sons of Dhritarashtra, his wounding of Duryodhana, and his defeat of Kritavarman.

shots.B07C113S01H01: Satyaki is attacked by Drona and many Kaurava princes, wounds Duryodhana until he flees, then overcomes Kritavarman and presses on through the Kaurava ranks.

B07C114.summary: Drona fights Satyaki in front of the army, and their duel is evenly matched. Satyaki's charioteer is knocked senseless, and Satyaki steers his own chariot while driving off Drona's attacks. He kills Drona's charioteer, sends the horses running, and the Kauravas flee, so Drona returns to guard his broken array.

scenes.B07C114S01: The duel between Drona and Satyaki, Satyaki's self-driving, and Drona's withdrawal to protect his array.

shots.B07C114S01H01: Drona and Satyaki trade arrows evenly, Drona's dart wounds Satyaki's charioteer, Satyaki drives himself, kills Drona's driver and scatters his horses, and Drona returns to hold the broken array.

B07C115.summary: Satyaki, who laughs at his enemies as already dead, drives on after defeating Drona and his allies. King Sudarsana tries to stop him, but Satyaki kills his horses and charioteer and then beheads Sudarsana. The Kaurava ranks are overwhelmed, and Satyaki presses on along the track Arjuna had taken.

scenes.B07C115S01: Satyaki's scornful remark, his killing of King Sudarsana, and his advance along Arjuna's track.

shots.B07C115S01H01: Satyaki mocks his foes, cuts down King Sudarsana's horses and charioteer and then beheads him, and drives on along Arjuna's path while the warriors marvel at him.

B07C116.summary: Satyaki urges his charioteer forward, describing the path Arjuna has cleared and the sound of Gandiva that tells him Jayadratha will fall before sunset. He faces the Yavanas, Kambojas, Sakas and other foreign troops, and his charioteer assures him he has nothing to fear. Satyaki vows to slaughter these warriors and drives into their ranks, cutting down thousands and routing the survivors, while the Charanas and Gandharvas applaud him.

scenes.B07C116S01: Satyaki's advance toward the foreign troops before Jayadratha, his charioteer's reassurance, his vow, and his slaughter of the Yavanas, Kambojas and Sakas.

shots.B07C116S01H01: Satyaki urges his charioteer across the blood-soaked ground toward the Kaurava ranks, saying Arjuna is near and Jayadratha will fall before sunset.
shots.B07C116S01H02: The charioteer says he is not afraid and reminds Satyaki that he has already beaten the Kambojas, Yavanas and Sakas.
shots.B07C116S01H03: Satyaki vows to kill these foreign troops and Duryodhana's allies, saying Duryodhana will grieve when he sees them slain.
shots.B07C116S01H04: Sanjaya narrates that the charioteer drives onward, Satyaki cuts down the Yavanas, Kambojas and Sakas in heaps, routs the survivors, and is praised by the heavenly musicians.

B07C117.summary: Satyaki drives through the Kaurava army toward Arjuna, shining like the sun and cutting down troops in great numbers. Duryodhana, Duhsasana, Sakuni and other princes gang up on him, but he wounds and routs them and cuts down Duryodhana's charioteer. The Kaurava army scatters, and Satyaki continues toward Arjuna's car while the Kaurava troops praise his skill.

scenes.B07C117S01: Satyaki's advance through the Kaurava army, his duel with Duryodhana and the princes, and the rout of the Kaurava forces.

shots.B07C117S01H01: Satyaki, glittering in gold and fighting like a hunter, mows down the Kaurava troops, beats off Duryodhana and his brothers in a long duel, kills Duryodhana's charioteer, and routs the army on his way to Arjuna.

B07C118.summary: Dhritarashtra despairs that his sons cannot stop Satyaki, and asks how one man can break through so many great warriors. Sanjaya blames the king's own counsel for the disaster, and describes how the Samsaptakas and other Kaurava forces rush at Satyaki, only to be slaughtered. When Duhsasana sends stone-throwing mountain tribesmen against him, Satyaki shatters their stones with arrows, and Drona, hearing the uproar, decides to go after him.

scenes.B07C118S01: Dhritarashtra's despair, Sanjaya's blame of the king, Satyaki's slaughter of the Samsaptakas and mountain tribesmen, and Drona's decision to pursue him.

shots.B07C118S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya how his sons could face Satyaki and says the Pandavas might as well lay down their arms, since Satyaki will surely destroy his sons.
shots.B07C118S01H02: Sanjaya blames the king's own evil counsel and describes the Samsaptakas, Duhsasana's stone-throwing hill tribesmen, and the Kaurava troops being slaughtered, and Drona hearing the uproar and turning to find Satyaki.

B07C119.summary: Drona upbraids Duhsasana for fleeing from one warrior, reminding him of the insults he hurled at Draupadi and urging him to make peace with the Pandavas if he has no stomach for battle. Duhsasana ignores him and goes off to fight Satyaki, while Drona charges the Pandava and Panchala ranks. Drona kills several princes, including Viraketu and the brothers Chitraketu and Chitravarman, then fights Dhrishtadyumna in a fierce duel, cuts off his charioteer's head, and routs the Panchalas before returning to his own line.

scenes.B07C119S01: Drona's rebuke of Duhsasana, Drona's slaughter of Panchala princes, his duel with Dhrishtadyumna, and his return to his own array.

shots.B07C119S01H01: Drona rebukes Duhsasana for fleeing, recalls his insults to Draupadi and his reckless gambling, and urges him to make peace before the Pandavas destroy them all; Duhsasana ignores him and goes to fight Satyaki. Drona then kills Viraketu and other Panchala princes, fights a fierce duel with Dhrishtadyumna, cuts off his charioteer's head, and routs the Panchalas before returning to his array.

B07C120.summary: Duhsasana charges Satyaki, but Satyaki shrouds him in arrows and routs his escort. The Trigarta warriors, sent by Duryodhana, come against Satyaki and lose five hundred men, and Duhsasana is stripped of his bow, chariot and charioteers. Satyaki spares Duhsasana because he remembers Bhima's vow to kill all of Dhritarashtra's sons, and then he moves on along Arjuna's path.

scenes.B07C120S01: Duhsasana's failed attack on Satyaki, the Trigarta assault and its defeat, Satyaki's sparing of Duhsasana, and his advance toward Arjuna.

shots.B07C120S01H01: Duhsasana fights Satyaki and is driven off, the Trigartas are cut down, Satyaki strips Duhsasana of his bow and chariot, spares his life for Bhima's sake, and rides on toward Arjuna.

B07C121.summary: Dhritarashtra asks how Satyaki alone could pass through his mighty army, and Sanjaya describes the fierce muster of both armies. Bhima and the Pandava princes urge their men to stop Satyaki and Arjuna, and Duryodhana drives deep into the Pandava host, wounding Bhima, Yudhishthira and others. Yudhishthira breaks Duryodhana's bow, but Drona comes to rescue the Kaurava king, and the battle grows more savage on every front.

scenes.B07C121S01: Dhritarashtra's questions, Sanjaya's account of the Pandava call to arms, Duryodhana's assault on the Pandava host, and Drona's rescue of Duryodhana.

shots.B07C121S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks why no warrior in his army could stop Satyaki, who passed through the whole host alone.
shots.B07C121S01H02: Sanjaya describes the vast muster of both armies, and the Pandava princes urging their men to stop Satyaki and Arjuna before they reach Jayadratha.
shots.B07C121S01H03: Dhritarashtra worries that Duryodhana, fighting alone against many, might have turned back.
shots.B07C121S01H04: Sanjaya says Duryodhana drives into the Pandava host, wounds Bhima, the twins, Yudhishthira and others, and then Yudhishthira breaks his bow before Drona rescues him.

B07C122.summary: In the afternoon Drona fights Vrihatkshatra, the Kekaya prince, and kills him after a long duel. Drona then slays Dhrishtaketu, the Chedi king, and his son, and the Panchalas begin to tremble. Drona also kills Jarasandha's son and Kshatradharman, and the Pandava host collapses until Drupada leads the Pandava princes against him.

scenes.B07C122S01: Drona's duels with Vrihatkshatra, Dhrishtaketu and his son, Jarasandha's son, Kshatradharman and Chekitana, and Drupada's counterattack.

shots.B07C122S01H01: Drona fights Vrihatkshatra, the Kekaya prince, in a long duel, and kills him after a clash of Brahma weapons and an arrow through his chest.
shots.B07C122S01H02: Dhrishtaketu of the Chedis attacks Drona, loses his bow, horses and charioteer, and is killed when Drona's arrow pierces him, and his son is also slain by Drona.
shots.B07C122S01H03: Drona kills Jarasandha's son, then the Panchala princes flee in dread, Kshatradharman is killed, and Chekitana is driven back; Drupada rallies the Pandavas to charge Drona.

B07C123.summary: The Pandava army is shaken, and Yudhishthira, unable to see Arjuna or Satyaki or hear Gandiva, grows anxious for both. He decides he must not seem to care only for his brother, and he resolves to send Bhima to aid Satyaki. He goes to Bhima and, overcome with grief, begs him to go to Arjuna and Satyaki and send word back.

scenes.B07C123S01: Yudhishthira's anxiety about Arjuna and Satyaki, and his decision to send Bhima after them.

shots.B07C123S01H01: Yudhishthira, unable to see or hear Arjuna and Satyaki, fears for them both and decides to send Bhima to help Satyaki, so that the world cannot blame him for caring only for his brother.

B07C124.summary: Bhima sets out after Yudhishthira's orders, handing the king over to Dhrishtadyumna. Yudhishthira blesses him, and Bhima rides off to the sound of the conches, with the Panchalas behind him. Drona tries to stop him, and Bhima replies with scorn, then hurls a mace that crushes Drona's chariot and begins slaughtering the Kaurava princes.

scenes.B07C124S01: Bhima's departure with Yudhishthira's blessing, his confrontation with Drona, and his killing of many of Dhritarashtra's sons.

shots.B07C124S01H01: Bhima tells Yudhishthira not to grieve and says he will go to Arjuna and Satyaki and send word back.
shots.B07C124S01H02: Bhima entrusts Yudhishthira to Dhrishtadyumna, saying he dares not disobey the king's order, and sets out in full armour, blessed with omens, while Yudhishthira blesses him.
shots.B07C124S01H03: Yudhishthira urges Bhima on again after hearing Krishna's conch, Bhima charges the Kaurava host, Drona warns him, Bhima answers with a challenge and hurls a mace that drives Drona's chariot into the ground, and Bhima kills Duhsasana's brothers and others while routing the Kaurava forces.

B07C125.summary: Bhima's great mace routs the Kaurava warriors who try to surround him, and Drona attacks him again. Bhima seizes Drona's chariot and throws it down, then crushes the Bhojas, Kambojas and other troops in his path. Hearing Arjuna and Krishna answer his shout, Yudhishthira is relieved and praises Arjuna, but he then frets about whether Jayadratha will fall before sunset.

scenes.B07C125S01: Bhima's mace attack, his duel with Drona and his advance through the Bhojas and Kambojas, and Yudhishthira's relief and anxious reflections.

shots.B07C125S01H01: Bhima's great mace routs the kings who surround him, and he pushes on through the Kaurava ranks like Garuda.
shots.B07C125S01H02: Drona attacks Bhima, who leaps down, throws down Drona's chariot, crushes the Bhoja and Kamboja divisions, and then shouts for Arjuna; Arjuna and Krishna answer with their own roars.
shots.B07C125S01H03: Yudhishthira praises Arjuna's past feats, rejoices at Bhima's message, and worries whether Arjuna can slay Jayadratha before sunset and whether Duryodhana will make peace.

B07C126.summary: Dhritarashtra asks who dared to stand against Bhima, whom he fears more than Arjuna or Krishna. Sanjaya answers that Karna charges Bhima, and the two exchange a long archery duel that ends with Bhima cutting Karna's bow, killing his charioteer and horses. Karna has to take another chariot, and Bhima's victory shout brings cheers from the Pandava side.

scenes.B07C126S01: Dhritarashtra's fearful question about who could stand against Bhima, and Karna's duel with Bhima, which Bhima wins.

shots.B07C126S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya who could stand against Bhima, saying he fears Bhima more than Arjuna, Krishna or Satyaki.
shots.B07C126S01H02: Karna challenges Bhima, the two trade arrows, Bhima cuts Karna's bow and kills his charioteer and horses, and Karna escapes to another chariot while Bhima's shout brings cheers from the Pandavas.

B07C127.summary: With the army routed and Arjuna and Bhima gone after Jayadratha, Duryodhana rides to Drona and asks for a plan. Drona says the Kauravas must defend Jayadratha, who is the real stake in this battle, and sends Duryodhana to guard him. On the way, Duryodhana fights the Panchala princes Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, crushes their chariots and then takes refuge on the chariot of the Madra king, while the two princes push on toward Arjuna.

scenes.B07C127S01: Duryodhana's appeal to Drona, Drona's plan to protect Jayadratha, and Duryodhana's fight with the two Panchala princes.

shots.B07C127S01H01: Duryodhana rides to Drona, complaining that Arjuna, Bhima and Satyaki have passed through his army and reached Jayadratha, and asks what should be done next.
shots.B07C127S01H02: Drona says the three Pandava heroes must be stopped, that Jayadratha is the real stake of this game of battle, and sends Duryodhana to guard him; Duryodhana then fights Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, disables their chariots and takes refuge on the Madra king's car while the two princes ride on toward Arjuna.
shots.B07C127S01H03: A heading marking the start of Section CXXX.

B07C128.summary: Karna turns to face Bhima, and Dhritarashtra asks in dismay how the two could fight, given Karna's past defeat and his bond with the Pandavas. Sanjaya describes how Bhima, despite wanting to reach Arjuna, is challenged by Karna and must fight him. The two trade a long, bitter series of arrows, Karna mocking Bhima and Bhima stung into fury, until Bhima cuts Karna's bow and kills his horses and charioteer, leaving Karna wounded and forced to seek another chariot.

scenes.B07C128S01: Sanjaya introduces Karna's attack on Bhima, Dhritarashtra's questions about their fight, and the duel that leaves Karna wounded and chariot-less.

shots.B07C128S01H01: Sanjaya says Karna charges Bhima like an elephant against an elephant as the combatants watch in fear.
shots.B07C128S01H02: Dhritarashtra asks how Bhima could fight Karna, who once lost to Bhima and who is famed as the greatest bowman, and asks Sanjaya to tell him the outcome.
shots.B07C128S01H03: Karna mocks Bhima for trying to flee to Arjuna, Bhima takes up the challenge, and after a long duel Bhima cuts Karna's bow, slays his horses and charioteer, and wounds him so that he must mount another car.

B07C129.summary: Dhritarashtra asks what Duryodhana said when Karna retreated, and how Bhima fought on. Sanjaya reports that Karna returns on a new chariot, and Bhima, stirred by his memories of the Kaurava wrongs, charges Karna in full fury. Karna blows his conch and counterattacks, and the battle turns into a fierce, even clash that kills many men and animals, and Krishna and Arjuna fear the burden is too much for Bhima.

scenes.B07C129S01: Dhritarashtra's questions about Karna's retreat, and the renewed duel in which Bhima recalls the Kaurava wrongs and fights on until the field is strewn with dead.

shots.B07C129S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what Duryodhana said when Karna retreated, and how Bhima and Karna fought on.
shots.B07C129S01H02: Karna returns on a new chariot, and Bhima, remembering the wrongs done to the Pandavas, charges with reckless fury; their duel is evenly matched, the field is strewn with dead, and Krishna and Arjuna see that the burden may be too heavy for Bhima.

B07C130.summary: Dhritarashtra, shaken by news of Karna's repeated defeats at Bhima's hands, asks Sanjaya to describe their duel and worries that his son's arrogance has doomed the Kauravas. Sanjaya reports a fierce exchange of arrows, with Bhima cutting Karna's bow and killing his charioteer and horses, and Karna's dart shot down by Bhima. Durjaya, Duryodhana's brother, rushes in to help Karna, but Bhima kills him, and Karna, weeping, is left surrounded by Bhima's arrows.

scenes.B07C130S01: Dhritarashtra's dismay at Karna's defeats, and Sanjaya's account of the duel in which Bhima kills Durjaya and surrounds Karna with arrows.

shots.B07C130S01H01: Dhritarashtra marvels at Bhima's skill against Karna, fears the Kauravas are already lost because of his son's arrogance and the Pandavas' repeated victories, and asks Sanjaya to describe the duel.
shots.B07C130S01H02: Sanjaya describes how Bhima cuts Karna's bow, kills his horses and charioteer, and shoots down Karna's dart; Durjaya rushes in to help Karna but is killed by Bhima, and Karna, weeping, is covered by Bhima's arrows.

B07C131.summary: Karna, beaten by Bhima once more, takes a fresh chariot and fights on, but Bhima smashes his steeds and charioteer and cuts down his banner, leaving him on foot. Duryodhana sends his brother Durmukha to help, and Bhima kills Durmukha with arrows. Karna is then badly wounded and flees, which shows how far Bhima has turned the battle against the Kaurava side.

scenes.B07C131S01: Karna's second chariot is wrecked, Durmukha is sent to his aid and killed by Bhima, and Karna retreats wounded while Bhima stays in the field.

shots.B07C131S01H01: Sanjaya describes Karna's chariot being broken, Durmukha's death, and Karna's wounded flight, all in one long report.

B07C132.summary: Dhritarashtra, hearing that Karna has been beaten, says fate rules everything, recalls Duryodhana's boasts about Karna, and fears for his sons against Bhima's might. Sanjaya rebukes him as the real cause of the war and its ruin, since he followed his sons' bad counsel. Sanjaya then reports that five more of the king's sons charged Bhima and were killed by his arrows, while Karna and Bhima glared at each other.

scenes.B07C132S01: Dhritarashtra laments Karna's defeat and blames fate; Sanjaya rebukes him and reports the deaths of five more sons at Bhima's hands.

shots.B07C132S01H01: Dhritarashtra laments that fate rules, recalls Duryodhana's boasts about Karna, and fears Bhima's strength for his sons.
shots.B07C132S01H02: Sanjaya tells the king he is the root of the disaster, since he followed his sons' counsel, and asks him to hear the battle report.
shots.B07C132S01H03: Five more sons of Dhritarashtra rush at Bhima and are killed by his arrows, while Karna and Bhima turn their anger on each other.

B07C133.summary: Karna, grieving over his dead sons, fights Bhima fiercely, and each man wounds and disarms the other in turn. Bhima breaks Karna's bow and Karna's mace attack fails, so Karna retreats on foot. When Duryodhana sends six more brothers against Bhima, he kills each with one arrow, and Karna returns in another chariot, both men bloodied.

scenes.B07C133S01: The duel between Karna and Bhima continues: Bhima breaks Karna's bow and mace attack, kills six of Duryodhana's brothers, and the two heroes keep trading heavy wounds.

shots.B07C133S01H01: Sanjaya gives a long account of the duel, the six brothers' deaths, and the king's sons losing heart.

B07C134.summary: Karna charges Bhima again, but Bhima wounds him heavily and roars in triumph. Duryodhana sends seven more brothers, and Bhima kills them all with arrows, grieving only for Vikarna, who had sided with the Pandavas. Yudhishthira hears Bhima's roar as a sign of victory and goes after Drona. Sanjaya then tells Dhritarashtra that his own refusal to heed Vidura's advice is the reason for the disaster.

scenes.B07C134S01: Karna's renewed charge, Bhima killing seven more brothers and roaring in triumph, Yudhishthira's advance on Drona, and Sanjaya's blame of Dhritarashtra.

shots.B07C134S01H01: Sanjaya's long report covers Karna's charge, Bhima's victory, Duryodhana's regret over Vidura's advice, and Sanjaya's blame of Dhritarashtra.

B07C135.summary: Dhritarashtra admits that his bad policy has brought this ruin and asks Sanjaya to describe the slaughter. Sanjaya reports that Karna and Bhima shower arrows on each other until the Kaurava troops, the Sindhus and the Sauviras among them, flee in terror. The field is strewn with bodies and broken weapons, and the chapter ends with Karna and Bhima compared to forest-burning fires.

scenes.B07C135S01: Dhritarashtra asks how the battle is going, and Sanjaya describes the carnage caused by Karna and Bhima and the rout of the Kaurava troops.

shots.B07C135S01H01: Dhritarashtra blames his own bad policy for the disaster and asks Sanjaya to report on the slaughter.
shots.B07C135S01H02: Sanjaya describes the arrow duel, the fleeing troops, the field covered with corpses and wreckage, and the closing comparison to fire in dry grass.

B07C136.summary: Karna and Bhima fight a long, savage duel: Bhima wounds Karna in the ear and forehead, Karna breaks Bhima's bow and chariot, and Bhima hurls objects and a sword in return. Bhima, now carless, is pinned down, and Karna mocks him as weak and fit only for the forest, but spares his life out of respect for Kunti and Arjuna's vow. Arjuna then arrives with Krishna, drives Karna off with his arrows, and turns against the Kaurava army as Ashwatthaman retreats.

scenes.B07C136S01: The long duel between Karna and Bhima: both sides break bows and cars, Karna taunts the carless Bhima but spares him, and Arjuna arrives to drive Karna away and rout the Kauravas.

shots.B07C136S01H01: Sanjaya gives a very long account of the duel, ending with Arjuna scattering Karna and the Kaurava army.

B07C137.summary: Dhritarashtra laments that his fame is fading and that Arjuna has broken into his army, fearing that the ruler of the Sindhus is already dead. He asks Sanjaya to describe how Satyaki fought in the thick of the battle. Sanjaya reports that Satyaki killed the Kaurava ally Alamvusha, then cut down the steeds of Duhsasana, and the chapter closes with Arjuna and Krishna rejoicing at his feats.

scenes.B07C137S01: Dhritarashtra laments the setbacks and asks about Satyaki; Sanjaya reports Satyaki's fight with Alamvusha, the death of Alamvusha, and his attack on Duhsasana's steeds.

shots.B07C137S01H01: Dhritarashtra laments his falling fame, Arjuna's entry into his army, and the likely death of the Sindhu ruler, then asks about Satyaki.
shots.B07C137S01H02: Sanjaya describes Satyaki's duel with Alamvusha, the death of Alamvusha, Satyaki's advance, and the closing joy of Arjuna and Krishna.

B07C138.summary: Satyaki, pushing deep into the Kaurava host to reach Arjuna, is surrounded by Trigarta warriors and beats them back, then drives through the Surasenas and Kalingas. Krishna announces his approach and praises him, but Arjuna frets over Yudhishthira, Jayadratha and the setting sun, and fears that the tired Satyaki will be overmatched by the fresh Bhurisravas. The chapter shows Arjuna torn between his duty to his friend and his larger battle plan.

scenes.B07C138S01: Satyaki cuts through the Trigarta, Surasena and Kalinga divisions to reach Arjuna, Krishna praises him, and Arjuna frets over Yudhishthira's safety and the danger to Satyaki from Bhurisravas.

shots.B07C138S01H01: Sanjaya tells how Satyaki beats back the Trigarta and other divisions and reaches Arjuna, and how Krishna and Arjuna react.

B07C139.summary: Bhurisravas, a Kuru warrior, challenges Satyaki with boasts, and Satyaki mocks him in reply. Their arrow duel turns into a sword fight, then a wrestling bout, with both men bloodied and worn down. Bhurisravas seizes Satyaki by the hair and is about to behead him, and Krishna urges Arjuna to act; Arjuna's arrow cuts off the arm that holds the sword.

scenes.B07C139S01: Bhurisravas and Satyaki fight with arrows, swords and wrestling until Bhurisravas grabs Satyaki by the hair, and Krishna urges Arjuna to intervene, which Arjuna does with an arrow that cuts off Bhurisravas's arm.

shots.B07C139S01H01: Bhurisravas taunts Satyaki and the two fight with arrows, swords and wrestling until both are exhausted and bloody.
shots.B07C139S01H02: Krishna urges Arjuna to save Satyaki from Bhurisravas, and Arjuna's arrow cuts off the arm holding the sword.

B07C140.summary: Arjuna cuts off Bhurisravas's arm just as he is about to kill Satyaki, and Bhurisravas angrily accuses him of unfairness. Arjuna answers that he was protecting his disciple, and reminds Bhurisravas of the wrong done to Abhimanyu. Bhurisravas then sits down to fast unto death, and Satyaki, despite the protests of the warriors, beheads him, which Satyaki defends, and the chapter closes with praise for Bhurisravas's end.

scenes.B07C140S01: Arjuna's arrow takes Bhurisravas's arm; Bhurisravas accuses Arjuna of foul play, Arjuna answers him, Bhurisravas fasts unto death, and Satyaki beheads him against the protests of others.
scenes.B07C140S02: Satyaki defends the killing, citing the death of Abhimanyu, and the chapter closes with the silent respect shown to Bhurisravas.

shots.B07C140S01H01: Sanjaya describes Bhurisravas's arm, cut off by Arjuna, falling to the ground, and Bhurisravas turning to rebuke Arjuna.
shots.B07C140S01H02: Bhurisravas accuses Arjuna of breaking the rules of war and of disgracing the Kshatriya code, and Arjuna answers that he was protecting Satyaki.
shots.B07C140S01H03: Bhurisravas sits down to die by fast, while Arjuna asks him to go to the heavenly regions and the crowd murmurs against Arjuna.
shots.B07C140S01H04: Krishna blesses Bhurisravas and tells him to go to his heavenly realm.
shots.B07C140S01H05: Satyaki, freed from Bhurisravas, draws his sword and beheads him while the warriors protest, and the gods and Siddhas applaud Bhurisravas's end.
shots.B07C140S02H01: Satyaki defends himself, recalling how the Kauravas killed Abhimanyu when he was unarmed, and quotes an old verse.
shots.B07C140S02H02: Sanjaya says that no one spoke up for Satyaki's act, and closes by praising Bhurisravas's courage and his death.

B07C141.summary: Dhritarashtra asks how Satyaki, so long unbeaten, could be thrown down by Bhurisravas. Sanjaya explains with the family history: Sini had carried off Devaki, Somadatta was thrown down by Sini in a wrestling bout, and Somadatta won a boon from Shiva for a son who would strike Sini's line. Sanjaya then praises the Vrishnis as unbeatable and blames Dhritarashtra's bad policy for all that has happened.

scenes.B07C141S01: Dhritarashtra asks why Satyaki was defeated, and Sanjaya gives the family history of Sini and Somadatta and the boon that explains the defeat.

shots.B07C141S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks how the unbeaten Satyaki could be thrown down by Bhurisravas.
shots.B07C141S01H02: Sanjaya traces the family lines of Satyaki and Bhurisravas, explains Somadatta's boon, praises the Vrishnis, and blames Dhritarashtra's policy.

B07C142.summary: With Bhurisravas dead, Arjuna urges Krishna to drive him at once toward Jayadratha, since the sun is sinking and he must kill the Sindhu king before sunset to keep his vow. Duryodhana, fearing that failure, begs Karna and the other leaders to block Arjuna, and Karna, though badly wounded, agrees to fight on. The chapter is a long account of Arjuna cutting down Kaurava warriors, Karna's charioteer and steeds falling, and Ashwatthaman stepping in to protect Jayadratha, with the sun now red in the sky.

scenes.B07C142S01: After Bhurisravas's death, Arjuna pushes toward Jayadratha, Duryodhana and Karna try to block him, Arjuna overwhelms their divisions and disables Karna, and Ashwatthaman protects the Sindhu king as the sun sinks.

shots.B07C142S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya how the battle went on after Bhurisravas's death.
shots.B07C142S01H02: Sanjaya describes Arjuna's push toward Jayadratha, the Kaurava leaders' efforts to stop him, Karna's disabling, and Ashwatthaman's rescue of the Sindhu king.

B07C143.summary: Arjuna sweeps through the Kaurava army with a celestial weapon, cutting down warriors and elephants until the field becomes a river of blood. As the sun nears setting, Krishna makes a false darkness so that Jayadratha thinks the day is over and looks up; Arjuna then beheads him with an arrow that carries the head to his father Vriddhakshatra's lap, and the old man's head shatters because of an old curse. The victory frees Yudhishthira to attack Drona in a night battle, and the chapter ends with the Pandavas triumphant.

scenes.B07C143S01: Arjuna's rampage through the Kaurava army, Krishna's illusion of sunset, Jayadratha's beheading and the curse-driven death of his father, and the night battle that follows.

shots.B07C143S01H01: Sanjaya describes Arjuna's celestial weapons, his rampage through the army, Krishna's illusion of sunset, Jayadratha's beheading, and the death of Vriddhakshatra.
shots.B07C143S01H02: Sanjaya says the darkness was revealed as an illusion, the Pandavas blow their conches, Yudhishthira attacks Drona, and Arjuna keeps fighting after his vow is fulfilled.
shots.B07C143S01H03: A heading that marks the start of the next section, Section CXLVI.

B07C144.summary: After Jayadratha falls, Kripa and Ashwatthaman attack Arjuna, who hits them only mildly out of respect for his teacher. Kripa collapses, and Arjuna laments that he has struck his own preceptor. Karna charges at Satyaki, and Krishna tells Arjuna that Satyaki can handle him and that Arjuna should not face Karna yet. Satyaki and Karna then duel from chariots, and Satyaki leaves Karna carless, while Sanjaya recounts the losses among Dhritarashtra's sons.

scenes.B07C144S01: Kripa and Ashwatthaman attack Arjuna, Arjuna grieves over his wounded teacher, and Krishna tells him Satyaki can handle Karna; Dhritarashtra asks how the Satyaki-Karna duel went, and Sanjaya explains Krishna's foresight and Satyaki's new chariot.
scenes.B07C144S02: Sanjaya describes the new chariots brought to Satyaki and Karna and tallies the sons of Dhritarashtra lost so far.

shots.B07C144S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks what his warriors did after Jayadratha's death.
shots.B07C144S01H02: Kripa and Ashwatthaman shower Arjuna with arrows, Kripa swoons, and Arjuna grieves that he has struck his teacher, while Krishna says Satyaki can handle Karna.
shots.B07C144S01H03: Dhritarashtra asks how the Satyaki-Karna duel went and what car Satyaki rode after losing his own.
shots.B07C144S01H04: Sanjaya explains that Krishna had foreseen Satyaki's defeat by Bhurisravas and had readied his car, and that Satyaki and Karna then fought furiously until Karna was left carless.
shots.B07C144S01H05: Dhritarashtra asks whether Satyaki rode another car after his duel with Karna.
shots.B07C144S02H01: Sanjaya describes the new chariots brought for Satyaki and Karna and recounts the sons of Dhritarashtra killed by Bhima, Satyaki and Arjuna.

B07C145.summary: Bhima, humiliated by Karna's taunts, reminds Arjuna of their vow and urges him to keep it. Arjuna answers Karna with contempt, vows to kill Karna's son Vrishasena, and the sun sets over the field. Krishna praises Arjuna for fulfilling his vow and then drives him across the battlefield, showing the heaps of dead kings and beasts, before he blows his conch and tells Yudhishthira that Jayadratha is dead.

scenes.B07C145S01: Bhima asks Arjuna to keep their vow, Arjuna answers Karna and vows to kill Vrishasena, Krishna praises Arjuna and shows him the battlefield, and Krishna tells Yudhishthira that Jayadratha is dead.

shots.B07C145S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks what Bhima did in the battle after the chariot duels.
shots.B07C145S01H02: Bhima reminds Arjuna of their vow and of Karna's insults, and Arjuna answers Karna, vows to kill Vrishasena, and receives Krishna's praise as the sun sets.
shots.B07C145S01H03: Krishna points out the battlefield to Arjuna, describing the dead kings, elephants, cars and riders strewn across the ground.
shots.B07C145S01H04: Krishna blows his conch, and he rides to Yudhishthira to tell him that Jayadratha is dead.

B07C146.summary: Krishna goes to Yudhishthira with news of Jayadratha's death, and the king, weeping with joy, embraces Krishna and Arjuna and praises Krishna as the lord of all worlds. Krishna and Arjuna recount how the Kauravas will be destroyed by Yudhishthira's wrath, and recall Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows. Arjuna then embraces the wounded Bhima and Satyaki and congratulates them on surviving Drona and Karna, and the Pandava army rallies with fresh resolve.

scenes.B07C146S01: Yudhishthira hears of Jayadratha's death and praises Krishna, Krishna and Arjuna predict the Kauravas' ruin, and Arjuna welcomes back the wounded Bhima and Satyaki.

shots.B07C146S01H01: Sanjaya describes Krishna's report to Yudhishthira, the king's joy and praise, the Kauravas' coming ruin, and Arjuna's welcome to Bhima and Satyaki, with the Pandava army regaining its resolve.

B07C147.summary: After Jayadratha's death, Duryodhana is crushed with grief and doubts that any warrior can match Arjuna. He goes to Drona, lists the Kaurava allies who have fallen, and swears that he will either destroy the Panchalas and Pandavas or die in the field to join them. He asks Drona's leave to go where his fallen allies have gone, which shows his desperation.

scenes.B07C147S01: Duryodhana grieves over Jayadratha's death and the slaughter of his army, goes to Drona, and vows to fight on to the end or die to join his fallen allies.

shots.B07C147S01H01: Sanjaya describes Duryodhana's despair after Jayadratha's death and his speech to Drona, in which he blames himself and swears to fight on.

B07C148.summary: Dhritarashtra asks how the Kauravas responded to the deaths of Jayadratha and Bhurisravas and what Drona said to Duryodhana. Drona answers with bitter reproach: he says Duryodhana ignored Vidura's warning, that the dice game and the insult to Draupadi brought this ruin, and that Arjuna could not be stopped. Still, he vows to fight on until the Panchalas are slain, and sends Duryodhana to tell Ashwatthaman to keep up the fight.

scenes.B07C148S01: Dhritarashtra asks about Duryodhana's grief, and Sanjaya reports Drona's bitter reply, his refusal to lay down arms, and his instructions to Ashwatthaman before he goes into battle.

shots.B07C148S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya how the Kauravas took the deaths of Jayadratha and Bhurisravas and what Drona said to Duryodhana.
shots.B07C148S01H02: Sanjaya reports the wailing in the Kaurava ranks and Drona's grief at Duryodhana's words.
shots.B07C148S01H03: Drona answers Duryodhana with a long reproach, blaming him for ignoring Vidura and the dice game, vowing to fight on, and sending a message to Ashwatthaman.

B07C149.summary: Duryodhana, stung by Drona's words, blames Drona for letting Arjuna pass through his formation and for allowing Jayadratha to be killed. Karna defends Drona, saying that Arjuna's youth, his weapons and Krishna's driving outmatched the old teacher, and that Fate has decided against the Kauravas. He urges Duryodhana to fight on regardless. The battle then resumes with fierce fighting between the two armies.

scenes.B07C149S01: Duryodhana blames Drona and Karna's defence follows, then the Pandava divisions advance and the battle resumes, with Sanjaya blaming Dhritarashtra's policy.

shots.B07C149S01H01: Duryodhana tells Karna that Arjuna passed through Drona's formation and killed Jayadratha, blaming Drona and his own refusal to let Jayadratha go home.
shots.B07C149S01H02: Karna defends Drona, blames Fate for the defeat, and urges Duryodhana to fight on despite the losses.
shots.B07C149S01H03: Sanjaya says the Pandava divisions advance and the battle resumes, and blames Dhritarashtra's evil policy.

B07C150.summary: In the gathering dark, the Kaurava and Panchala forces clash everywhere, and Duryodhana drives into the Pandava host, scorching it with arrows until the Panchalas and Pandavas begin to flee. Yudhishthira cuts his bow and wounds him, and Duryodhana sits down on his car as a cry goes up that the king is slain. Duryodhana recovers, attacks again, and Drona steps in to guard him, so the battle grows fiercer. The chapter opens a new section, the Ghatotkacha-badha Parva, marked by a heading.

scenes.B07C150S01: Duryodhana breaks into the Pandava host, Yudhishthira wounds him, a rumor says the king is slain, and Drona comes to Duryodhana's rescue as the battle deepens.

shots.B07C150S01H01: A heading that names the Ghatotkacha-badha Parva.
shots.B07C150S01H02: Sanjaya describes the fighting in the dusk, Duryodhana's assault on the Pandava host, Yudhishthira's wounding of him, the false cry of the king's death, and Drona's rescue.

B07C151.summary: Dhritarashtra asks who protected Drona and how he died, and Sanjaya describes the Pandavas closing in on Drona at night with their divisions. The dark battle becomes a chaos of noise, blood and dust in which friend and foe cannot be told apart, and the sounds of animals and weapons fill the field. Drona, despite the odds, cuts down thousands of elephants, chariots and foot-soldiers that night.

scenes.B07C151S01: Dhritarashtra asks about Drona's protectors, and Sanjaya describes the Pandava divisions converging on Drona in the night and the chaotic battle that follows.

shots.B07C151S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks who protected Drona and how such a great warrior could be brought down.
shots.B07C151S01H02: Sanjaya describes the Pandava divisions converging on Drona in the dark, the omens, the confused night battle, and Drona's slaughter of enemy troops.

B07C152.summary: Dhritarashtra asks how Drona fared in the night fight and who stood by him, and Sanjaya describes the chaotic clash. Drona kills many Panchala and Pandava warriors, including Sivi, and the Kalinga prince is killed by Bhima with his fists. Bhima crushes several Kaurava warriors, and Durmada and Dushkarna are destroyed when he sinks their chariot into the earth, so that kings flee in terror and the Pandavas honor Bhima.

scenes.B07C152S01: Dhritarashtra asks about the night battle, and Sanjaya reports Drona's kills, Bhima's fist-fights with the Kalinga prince and others, and the flight of the Kaurava kings.

shots.B07C152S01H01: Dhritarashtra asks a string of questions about Drona's fight and who was with him, and how the Pandavas and his own troops fared that night.
shots.B07C152S01H02: Sanjaya reports Drona's kills, Bhima's fist-fights with the Kalinga prince, Dhruva and others, the destruction of Durmada and Dushkarna, and the Pandavas' honor to Bhima as the Kaurava kings flee.

B07C153.summary: Somadatta, enraged at Bhurisravas's death, swears to kill Satyaki, but Satyaki stands firm and wounds him until he falls senseless. Drona then breaks into the Pandava host, driving back Yudhishthira and the others, until Arjuna and Bhima turn toward him. Ghatotkacha attacks Drona's son Ashwatthaman on a fearsome iron chariot, and Ashwatthaman kills Ghatotkacha's son Anjanaparvan, and Ashwatthaman then fights through a huge Rakshasa army, killing many Pandava princes. Ghatotkacha is finally pierced by an arrow from Ashwatthaman and is carried off the field, apparently dead, while the Kauravas applaud Ashwatthaman.

scenes.B07C153S01: Somadatta and Satyaki duel, Drona drives into the Pandava host and is met by Arjuna and Bhima, and Ghatotkacha and Ashwatthaman clash, with Ashwatthaman killing Anjanaparvan and the two trading threats.
scenes.B07C153S02: Duryodhana sends Sakuni against the Pandavas, Ashwatthaman destroys the Rakshasa army and kills several Pandava princes, and Ghatotkacha is struck down and carried off.

shots.B07C153S01H01: Sanjaya describes Somadatta's vow against Satyaki, their duel and Somadatta's collapse, Drona's rampage through the Pandava host, Arjuna and Bhima turning to face him, and Ashwatthaman's fight with Ghatotkacha, in which Anjanaparvan is killed.
shots.B07C153S01H02: Ghatotkacha challenges Ashwatthaman to fight him.
shots.B07C153S01H03: Ashwatthaman answers that a father and son should not fight, and that he bears no grudge against Ghatotkacha.
shots.B07C153S01H04: Ghatotkacha insists on the fight and conjures an illusion, which Ashwatthaman dispels with his own weapons; Ashwatthaman then warns Duryodhana to stand aside while he fights.
shots.B07C153S01H05: Duryodhana replies that Ashwatthaman's generosity is great.
shots.B07C153S02H01: Ashwatthaman orders Sakuni and a large force to attack the Pandavas, to be joined by Karna, Kripa, Salya and others.
shots.B07C153S02H02: Sanjaya describes Ashwatthaman's slaughter of the Rakshasa army, the battle with Ghatotkacha and Dhrishtadyumna, a river of blood, the killing of several Pandava princes, and the mortal wounding of Ghatotkacha, who is then carried off.

B07C154.summary: Somadatta, still enraged, fights Satyaki until Bhima hits him with a mace and a shaft, knocking him senseless. Bhima then kills a string of Kaurava warriors, including Valhika and Somadatta's sons, while Yudhishthira destroys Kaurava divisions. Drona and Yudhishthira duel with celestial weapons until Drona's Brahma weapon is answered in kind, and Drona finally turns on the Panchalas, sending the Kaurava host into flight.

scenes.B07C154S01: The night fight continues: Bhima kills Valhika and many Kaurava warriors, Yudhishthira routs Kaurava divisions, and Drona and Yudhishthira duel with celestial weapons before the Kaurava host is scattered by Arjuna and Bhima.

shots.B07C154S01H01: Sanjaya describes Somadatta's duel with Satyaki, Bhima's killing of Valhika and of many Kaurava princes and allies, and the wavering of the kings.
shots.B07C154S01H02: Yudhishthira destroys Kaurava divisions, Drona and Yudhishthira trade celestial weapons, and Arjuna and Bhima drive the routed Kaurava host back.

B07C155.summary: Duryodhana, facing the massed Pandava army, begs Karna to save his warriors, and Karna boasts that he will kill Arjuna with the dart given to him by Indra. Kripa mocks Karna's boasting, reminding him of past defeats and listing the Pandavas' many allies, including Ghatotkacha. Karna rejects the reproach, boasts again that he will kill Arjuna and Krishna and give Duryodhana the earth, and insists that victory rests with Fate.

scenes.B07C155S01: Duryodhana appeals to Karna, Karna boasts, Kripa mocks him and lists the Pandava allies, and Karna answers with fresh threats and insists that the outcome depends on Fate.

shots.B07C155S01H01: Duryodhana, facing the surging Pandava army, asks Karna to save his warriors.
shots.B07C155S01H02: Karna boasts that he will kill Arjuna with Indra's dart and give Duryodhana victory.
shots.B07C155S01H03: Kripa mocks Karna's boasting, reminding him of past defeats and saying his words are idle.
shots.B07C155S01H04: Kripa lists the allies of the Pandavas and warns that the Pandavas cannot be overcome.
shots.B07C155S01H05: Karna answers Kripa with scorn, threatens him, and insists that victory depends on Fate.

B07C156.summary: Karna insults Kripa, and Ashwatthaman, enraged, charges at him until Duryodhana and Kripa hold him back, and Karna is then spared at Duryodhana's urging. Karna then fights the Pandava host with great skill, but Arjuna cuts down his bow, steeds and charioteer, and Karna flees in Kripa's chariot. Duryodhana tries to rally his troops and go against Arjuna himself, but Ashwatthaman promises to hold Arjuna back, and Duryodhana, doubting him, urges him instead to slay the Panchalas and Somakas.

scenes.B07C156S01: Ashwatthaman charges Karna over his insults to Kripa, and Duryodhana and Kripa restrain him, while Karna is forgiven.
scenes.B07C156S02: Karna fights the Pandavas with great skill until Arjuna disables him, Duryodhana tries to rally his forces, and Ashwatthaman and Kripa move to stop Arjuna.
scenes.B07C156S03: Duryodhana reproaches Ashwatthaman for holding back and urges him to slay the Panchalas and Somakas.

shots.B07C156S01H01: Ashwatthaman, seeing his uncle Kripa insulted, rushes at Karna in fury.
shots.B07C156S01H02: Ashwatthaman rebukes Karna, saying Arjuna's feats show how weak his boasts are, and vows to behead him.
shots.B07C156S01H03: Kripa and Duryodhana hold Ashwatthaman back, and Karna asks that he be let go.
shots.B07C156S01H04: Ashwatthaman forgives Karna for now, saying Arjuna will bring down his pride.
shots.B07C156S01H05: Duryodhana urges Ashwatthaman to calm down and forgive, pointing to the Pandava army coming against Karna.
shots.B07C156S02H01: Sanjaya says Ashwatthaman's anger is calmed, and Kripa, who is mild in temper, returns to speak.
shots.B07C156S02H02: Kripa forgives Karna in the same way, saying Arjuna will humble his pride.
shots.B07C156S02H03: Karna holds the Pandava host off with clouds of arrows, leaving the enemy kings dazed and their troops heaped with the dead, and Duryodhana asks Ashwatthaman to block Arjuna.
shots.B07C156S02H04: Dhritarashtra asks what Karna did when he met Arjuna, the foe he had always challenged.
shots.B07C156S02H05: Sanjaya describes Arjuna's duel with Karna, in which Arjuna cuts Karna's bow, steeds and charioteer, and Karna flees on Kripa's chariot, after which Duryodhana tries to rally his men and go against Arjuna, and Ashwatthaman and Kripa move to stop him.
shots.B07C156S03H01: Duryodhana tells Ashwatthaman that Drona always shields the Pandavas and urges him to slay the Panchalas and Somakas.

B07C157.summary: Ashwatthaman, egged on by Duryodhana, vows to fight recklessly and to slay many enemies, and mocks the king for his suspicions. He charges into the Panchalas and Somakas, who attack him in force. Dhrishtadyumna meets him in a long duel, and when Ashwatthaman destroys his chariot and kills many Panchalas, the enemy troops scatter. The Kauravas applaud Ashwatthaman's triumph.

scenes.B07C157S01: Ashwatthaman vows to fight recklessly for Duryodhana, Dhrishtadyumna duels with him, Ashwatthaman destroys his chariot and kills many Panchalas, and the Kauravas applaud his triumph.

shots.B07C157S01H01: Sanjaya describes Ashwatthaman's vow to fight recklessly for Duryodhana, his duel with Dhrishtadyumna, the destruction of Dhrishtadyumna's chariot, and his triumph over the Panchalas, as the Kauravas applaud him.
shots.B07C157S01H02: A heading that marks the start of Section CLX.

B07C158.summary: Yudhishthira and Bhima surround Ashwatthaman, and Duryodhana, aided by Drona, rushes to the fight. Yudhishthira destroys many kings' divisions, and Arjuna and Bhima attack Drona's army from both flanks, while Drona routs the Panchalas with the Vayavya weapon. In the gloom the Kaurava host breaks, and many kings flee in terror.

scenes.B07C158S01: Yudhishthira and Bhima surround Ashwatthaman, Duryodhana joins the fight with Drona, Arjuna and Bhima hit Drona from both flanks, and the Kaurava host breaks in the dark.

shots.B07C158S01H01: Sanjaya describes Yudhishthira and Bhima surrounding Ashwatthaman, Duryodhana and Drona joining the fight, the slaughter of many divisions, and the rout of the Kaurava host in the darkness.

B07C159.summary: Satyaki, determined to kill Somadatta, duels with him at length, cutting down each other's bows, standards and steeds. Satyaki finally kills Somadatta with a fiery arrow, and the Kaurava warriors rush at Satyaki in grief. Meanwhile Yudhishthira fights Drona, who cuts his bow and standard, and Krishna urges Yudhishthira to leave the preceptor and go to Bhima and Arjuna, which he does.

scenes.B07C159S01: Satyaki duels Somadatta until he kills him, Yudhishthira is worn down by Drona, and Krishna urges Yudhishthira to turn to Bhima instead.

shots.B07C159S01H01: Sanjaya describes Satyaki's duel with Somadatta, Somadatta's death, Yudhishthira's clash with Drona, and Krishna's advice to Yudhishthira to leave Drona and join Bhima.

B07C160.summary: In the dark night the fighters cannot see each other and recognize one another only by voice and name, and many warriors flee or are killed in confusion. Duryodhana orders the foot-soldiers to carry lamps, and the Kaurava host is lit up and reorganized under Drona, with Ashwatthaman and Sakuni on the flanks. The Pandavas answer by lighting their own lamps, and the whole field becomes a blazing scene as the fighting resumes.

scenes.B07C160S01: The night battle is confused and deadly, Dhritarashtra asks how the armies could see again, and Sanjaya describes the lamps lit by both sides and the renewed battle under the glow.

shots.B07C160S01H01: Sanjaya describes how in the dark the warriors fight by name and voice, and many are killed or flee in confusion.
shots.B07C160S01H02: Dhritarashtra asks how the minds of the warriors fared in the darkness and how the armies became visible again.
shots.B07C160S01H03: Sanjaya describes the Kaurava army's reorganization, Duryodhana's order to light lamps, the lit host, and the Pandavas' answering lights, ending with Ashwatthaman scorching the Pandavas.

B07C161.summary: With the lamps blazing, the two armies fight with fresh fury, and Arjuna pushes into the Kaurava ranks, weakening the kings. Dhritarashtra demands to know how Drona fared against Arjuna and who guarded him. Duryodhana then orders his brothers and the Trigartas to shield Drona, and the battle resumes in full force.

scenes.B07C161S01: The lit battlefield sees fresh combat, Arjuna breaks into the Kaurava ranks, Dhritarashtra asks about Drona's guard, and Duryodhana orders his men to protect Drona.

shots.B07C161S01H01: Sanjaya describes the lit field, the duels between heroes, and Arjuna's sweep through the Kaurava ranks.
shots.B07C161S01H02: Dhritarashtra asks what the Kaurava soldiers thought when Arjuna entered the army and who protected Drona.
shots.B07C161S01H03: Duryodhana orders his brothers and the Trigartas to shield Drona, names Dhrishtadyumna as the main threat, and the battle resumes with heavy losses on both sides.

B07C162.summary: Yudhishthira orders the Pandava and Panchala forces to focus on Drona, and each Kaurava warrior is assigned a foe to block them, including Kritavarman against Yudhishthira. The duel between Yudhishthira and Kritavarman goes badly for Yudhishthira, who is stripped of his chariot, weapons and armour and must retreat. Kritavarman then returns to guard Drona's chariot wheel.

scenes.B07C162S01: Yudhishthira orders an attack on Drona, the Kaurava warriors pair off against the Pandava leaders, and Kritavarman defeats Yudhishthira, who withdraws from the field.

shots.B07C162S01H01: Sanjaya describes Yudhishthira ordering the attack on Drona, the pairing of Kaurava and Pandava champions, and Kritavarman's defeat of Yudhishthira, who withdraws from battle.

B07C163.summary: Satyaki kills the Kuru warrior Bhuri with a dart, and Ashwatthaman then charges him, drawing in Ghatotkacha, who wounds Ashwatthaman badly before Ashwatthaman finally pierces him and drives him from the field. Duryodhana then fights Bhima, cutting down bow after bow until Bhima hurls a mace that crushes Duryodhana's chariot, forcing him to flee. Believing Duryodhana dead, the Pandavas press on, and the night battle against Drona continues.

scenes.B07C163S01: Satyaki kills Bhuri, Ashwatthaman and Ghatotkacha duel until Ghatotkacha is carried off, and Duryodhana fights Bhima until Bhima's mace forces him to flee, leading the Pandavas to believe he is dead.

shots.B07C163S01H01: Sanjaya describes Satyaki's duel with Bhuri and Bhuri's death, Ashwatthaman's attack on Satyaki, the duel between Ashwatthaman and Ghatotkacha, and Ghatotkacha's removal from the field.
shots.B07C163S01H02: Sanjaya describes Duryodhana and Bhima fighting until Bhima's mace crushes Duryodhana's chariot, the Kauravas' panic at the news of his death, and the renewed battle around Drona.

B07C164.summary: Karna faces Sahadeva, cutting down his bow, chariot, weapons and steeds until Sahadeva is left helpless. Karna mocks him and sends him off to fight his equals, telling him to go to Arjuna or home. Karna spares Sahadeva, out of respect for Kunti's wishes, and Sahadeva, beaten and mocked, climbs into another chariot.

scenes.B07C164S01: Karna defeats Sahadeva, mocks him and spares his life for Kunti's sake, and Sahadeva withdraws from the fight.

shots.B07C164S01H01: Sanjaya describes Karna's defeat of Sahadeva, his mocking words and his decision to spare him, and Sahadeva's withdrawal.

B07C165.summary: Salya fights Virata, kills his horses and Satanika, and wounds him so that he falls senseless. The Pandava troops flee before Salya, so Krishna and Arjuna move toward him, and the Rakshasa Alamvusha challenges Arjuna. Arjuna cuts down Alamvusha's chariot, bow and steeds, and drives him off, then presses on toward Drona while the enemy flees.

scenes.B07C165S01: Salya defeats Virata and Satanika, the Pandava troops flee, Alamvusha challenges Arjuna, and Arjuna overcomes him and drives on toward Drona.

shots.B07C165S01H01: Sanjaya describes Salya's duel with Virata and Satanika, the rout of the Pandava troops, the Rakshasa Alamvusha's challenge to Arjuna, and Arjuna's victory and advance toward Drona.

B07C166.summary: Chitrasena's armour and bow are cut off by Satanika, and Chitrasena is left without chariot or weapons. Vrishasena fights Drupada, and Drupada is pierced in the chest and carried off, which leaves the Panchalas fleeing. Duhsasana then duels with Prativindhya, destroys his chariot and bow, and fights on until Prativindhya's brothers arrive and the battle turns into a general melee in the dark.

scenes.B07C166S01: Satanika strips Chitrasena of his armour and weapons, Vrishasena defeats Drupada and drives the Panchalas off, and Duhsasana fights Prativindhya until a general melee breaks out.

shots.B07C166S01H01: Sanjaya describes Satanika stripping Chitrasena of his armour, bow, chariot and steeds, and Chitrasena's retreat onto Hridika's son's chariot.
shots.B07C166S01H02: Sanjaya describes Vrishasena's duel with Drupada, Drupada's wounding and withdrawal, and the Panchalas fleeing from Karna's son.
shots.B07C166S01H03: Sanjaya describes Duhsasana's duel with Prativindhya, Prativindhya's loss of chariot and bow, his brothers' arrival, and the general melee at midnight.

B07C167.summary: Sakuni and Nakula trade blows until Sakuni wounds Nakula, but Nakula recovers, cuts down Sakuni's bow, standard and chariot, and leaves him badly hurt. Kripa and Sikhandin also duel until Sikhandin is driven back by Kripa's arrows. The night fight spreads into a chaos in which men cannot tell friend from foe and even kin kill one another.

scenes.B07C167S01: Nakula defeats Sakuni, Kripa drives back Sikhandin, and the night battle grows so confused that warriors slay their own kin.

shots.B07C167S01H01: Sanjaya describes Nakula's duel with Sakuni, Sakuni's wounding and downfall, Kripa's fight with Sikhandin, and the chaos of the night battle in which men kill their own side.

B07C168.summary: Dhrishtadyumna charges at Drona, but Drona cuts down his bow, and Karna and other Kaurava warriors gang up on him until he kills Drumasena and cuts off Karna's bow. Satyaki then comes to his aid and duels with Karna, wounding Vrishasena until he seems dead, and Karna, grief-stricken, presses Satyaki hard. Karna then hears Arjuna's bowstring and tells Duryodhana to kill Satyaki and Dhrishtadyumna, and Duryodhana sends Sakuni out to fight Arjuna while Drona again battles Dhrishtadyumna.

scenes.B07C168S01: Dhrishtadyumna charges Drona and fights Karna and the Kaurava champions, Satyaki duels Karna and Vrishasena, Karna hears Arjuna's bowstring and urges Duryodhana to target Satyaki and Dhrishtadyumna, and Sakuni sets out against Arjuna.

shots.B07C168S01H01: Sanjaya describes Dhrishtadyumna's assault on Drona and the battle with Karna and his allies, Satyaki's duel with Karna and Vrishasena, Karna's warning about Arjuna, and Duryodhana's orders to Sakuni.

B07C169.summary: The Kaurava kings surround Satyaki, but he cuts down many warriors with razor-headed arrows and routs Duryodhana, who loses his chariot and bow and flees on Kritavarman's chariot.
